carousel.title: Mark sacred time.
carousel.text: LIT Bible quietly honors the church year by adorning your reading with the liturgical season’s colors: royal blue through Advent, red for the twelve days of Christmas, purple in Lent, gold for Easter, and forest green through Ordinary Time. Or choose from one of our hand-picked alternatives.
carousel.stageLabel: Hebrews chapter 1, cycling through five liturgical seasons
